description: Focused V13.6 gated repair space: existing backbone/care levers plus disease-history repair parameters; PrEP parameters are held from the incoming baseline and treated as audit-only.

parameters.name: orient_female
parameters.notes: Female multiplier relative to the fixed heterosexual-male reference of 1.0.

parameters.name: orient_msm
parameters.notes: MSM multiplier relative to the fixed heterosexual-male reference of 1.0.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1985
parameters.notes: Effective diagnosis probability in the early HIV testing era.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1990
parameters.notes: Effective diagnosis probability for the intermediate second/third-generation testing era.

parameters.name: diagnosis_1997
parameters.notes: Effective diagnosis probability for the modern fourth-generation testing era.

parameters.name: diagnosis_2015
parameters.notes: Effective diagnosis probability after intensified Amsterdam PrEP-era testing policy.

parameters.name: art_init_1996
parameters.notes: First ART-available year. The fixed 1995 anchor remains 0.0.

parameters.name: chronic_to_aids
parameters.notes: V13.6 focused repair: chronic-to-AIDS progression. Bounds are wider than the current narrow point estimate but remain in a literature-plausible diagnostic range.

parameters.name: chronic_to_aids_on_art
parameters.notes: V13.6 focused repair: on-ART chronic-to-AIDS progression sensitivity within existing config bounds.

parameters.name: aids_mortality
parameters.notes: V13.6 focused repair: AIDS-stage mortality. Upper bound stays below the broad legacy 0.45 stress-test because diagnostics showed extreme mortality can collapse stocks.

parameters.name: art_mortality_reduction
parameters.notes: V13.6 focused repair: ART reduction in HIV-attributable mortality within existing evidence bounds.

fixed_parameters.name: orient_het_male
fixed_parameters.reason: Reference orientation multiplier for calibration. Female and MSM are estimated relative to heterosexual males.

fixed_parameters.name: art_init_1995
fixed_parameters.reason: Hard no-ART anchor before the 1996 ART availability year; prevents calibration from fitting a 1995 ART uptake value.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Historical oral PrEP must be active when fitting the 2019-2025 CSG programme targets.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_lenacapavir_disabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Lenacapavir was not available during the historical PrEP calibration period.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_activity_classes
fixed_parameters.reason: Historical uptake is not restricted to the model's theoretical High activity group; lower activity MSM remain eligible with lower uptake intensity.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_low_modifier
fixed_parameters.reason: Low-activity MSM retain nonzero historical uptake because real PrEP indication includes situational risk not captured by fixed activity class.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_medium_modifier
fixed_parameters.reason: Reference uptake intensity for historical PrEP calibration.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_high_modifier
fixed_parameters.reason: Higher historical uptake intensity among high-activity MSM without making PrEP High-only.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_oral_prep_stock_corridor_enabled
fixed_parameters.reason: Historical PrEP exposure is externally observed during the CSG pilot and should remain inside the empirical stock corridor during joint calibration.

fixed_parameters.name: historical_lenacapavir_stock_corridor_disabled
fixed_parameters.reason: The generic corridor mechanism supports lenacapavir, but it must remain inactive for the historical Netherlands period because lenacapavir was not available.

excluded_parameters.name: beta_vaginal_mtf
excluded_parameters.reason: Route-specific betas are literature-defined biological parameters. Their uncertainty should be handled in PSA, not pre-PSA calibration.

excluded_parameters.name: beta_vaginal_ftm
excluded_parameters.reason: Route-specific betas are literature-defined biological parameters. Their uncertainty should be handled in PSA, not pre-PSA calibration.

excluded_parameters.reason: V13.6 gate repair keeps PrEP audit-only; incoming baseline value is retained rather than using PrEP to force incidence fit.
